name: LTE & 5G Security Assessment
description: Ability to assess the security of LTE (4G) and 5G NR cellular networks. Covers LTE/5G air interface analysis, authentication and key agreement (AKA) assessment, rogue base station (fake eNodeB/gNodeB) detection and analysis, NAS and RRC protocol security, network slicing isolation, and assessment of subscriber privacy protections including SUPI/SUCI mechanisms.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to LTE or 5G security assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands LTE and 5G network architecture and security mechanisms
evidence: Can describe the LTE protocol stack (PHY, MAC, RLC, PDCP, RRC, NAS) and security functions
Understands EPS-AKA and 5G-AKA authentication mechanisms at a conceptual level
Completed training on LTE/5G security architecture and known vulnerability classes

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Performs LTE signal analysis and base station characterization under supervision
evidence: Decoded LTE MIB and SIB messages to characterize cell parameters using srsRAN or equivalent under guidance
Identified LTE cell IDs, frequencies, bandwidths, and security configurations
Operated srsRAN or Open5GS test infrastructure in a shielded environment under supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses LTE/5G security in controlled environments
evidence: Independently analyzed LTE network security configurations across 3+ assessments
Assessed subscriber privacy by analyzing IMSI exposure, paging, and tracking attack surfaces
Configured and operated LTE/5G test infrastructure for controlled security analysis
Produced detailed reports documenting protocol-level findings and remediation recommendations

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Performs advanced LTE/5G protocol analysis; assesses 5G-specific security features
evidence: Assessed 5G network slicing isolation and inter-slice security boundaries
Analyzed NAS and RRC protocol implementations for non-standard behavior or vulnerabilities
Evaluated 5G SUPI/SUCI privacy mechanisms and their implementation correctness
Developed custom LTE/5G analysis tools and mentors junior staff on assessment methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Recognized authority on LTE/5G security; discovers implementation vulnerabilities; defines lab methodology
evidence: Published research on LTE or 5G security vulnerabilities or assessment techniques
Discovered novel protocol-level vulnerabilities in LTE or 5G implementations
Authored the lab's LTE/5G security assessment methodology
Trains teams on LTE/5G security and advises operators on network hardening

assessment_methods.description: Analyze a controlled LTE test network: decode system information, assess authentication configuration, evaluate subscriber privacy protections, and document findings
Given a 5G network architecture diagram, identify security assessment priorities and design a test plan addressing authentication, slicing isolation, and privacy

equipment: RF shielded enclosure for cellular testing
